title: bioinfo-kaust/hybrid-metatranscriptomics pipeline parameters
description: Host-only transcriptome reconstruction from long + short reads with pre-assembly decontamination, annotation, quantification and DGE

longread_input.description: Sample,condition,reads (fasta/fastq[.gz]); null disables the long-read side.
longread_input.help_text: Validated against assets/schema_longread.json when the run starts; `null` (or leaving it unset) disables it.

longread_membership.description: Long reads that were pooled before the pipeline saw them (a polished Iso-Seq set, say) carry no per-sample identity.
longread_membership.help_text: Long reads that were pooled before the pipeline saw them (a polished Iso-Seq set, say) carry no per-sample identity. Point this at a 'sequence_id<TAB>sample' table to recover it — extra/pacbio_fl_counts_to_membership.py builds one from a PacBio FL count matrix.

assembly_input.description: Extra short-read libraries used ONLY to assemble the reference (StringTie + Trinity): same preprocessing as --input, never quantified or tested.
assembly_input.help_text: Extra short-read libraries used ONLY to assemble the reference (StringTie + Trinity): same preprocessing as --input, never quantified or tested. For public libraries of the same species that assemble better than the experiment's own. Same columns as `input`; the condition column may be empty. Their strandedness must match `strandedness`. null = none. Validated against assets/schema_input.json when the run starts; `null` (or leaving it unset) disables it.

reference_genome_options.title: Reference genome
reference_genome_options.description: Optional host genome: enables the genome-guided routes, salmon decoys and the locus gene map.

genome.description: Give a local FASTA, or an NCBI accession to download with `datasets`.
genome.help_text: Give a local FASTA, or an NCBI accession to download with `datasets`. Optional: with neither, the genome-guided routes, SQANTI3 and the locus gene map are skipped, salmon runs without decoys, and decontamination removes every read that places on a contaminant.

star_index.description: Prebuilt STAR index dir; built when null.

contaminant_options.title: Contaminant / symbiont set
contaminant_options.description: Genomes whose reads are removed before assembly. All null = no decontamination.

contaminant_fasta.description: Genomes whose reads must be removed BEFORE assembly.
contaminant_fasta.help_text: Genomes whose reads must be removed BEFORE assembly. Any one of: contaminant_fasta       - a single (already combined) FASTA contaminant_dir         - a directory of FASTA files, concatenated by the pipeline contaminant_accessions  - comma-separated NCBI accessions, downloaded and concatenated All three null = decontamination is skipped (same as --skip_decontam).

contaminant_prefix.description: Scaffold-name prefix that marks contaminant sequence.

contaminant_margin.description: Best-residue-match margin for the long-read classifier.

rrna_fasta.description: Local FASTA; downloaded from rrna_db_urls when null.

rrna_db_base.description: Base URL of the SortMeRNA rRNA databases.

rrna_db_sets.description: Comma-separated SortMeRNA rRNA database names to download from rrna_db_base.

rrna_kmer.description: K-mer length for bbduk rRNA matching.

diamond_db_dir.description: Dir with prebuilt <name>.dmnd files; built when null.

primary_protein_db.description: Which DIAMOND database supplies the generic protein_hit / protein_desc columns that the locus validation, the figures, the dashboard and the interest regex all key on.
primary_protein_db.help_text: Which DIAMOND database supplies the generic protein_hit / protein_desc columns that the locus validation, the figures, the dashboard and the interest regex all key on. Without this the integrator falls back to alphabetical order, which silently promoted the small specialist DB (toxprot, 1,021 hits) over Swiss-Prot (28,059).

swissprot_url.description: URL of the Swiss-Prot FASTA used to build the primary DIAMOND database.

specialist_name.help_text: Second (specialist) DIAMOND DB. Default = UniProt Tox-Prot (reviewed animal toxins). Set specialist_url = null to run with Swiss-Prot only.

interproscan_db.description: InterProScan data/ directory; null = the installation's own.

interest_regex.description: Regex flagging a gene family of interest in the annotation table (column of_interest).
interest_regex.help_text: Regex flagging a gene family of interest in the annotation table (column of_interest). Word boundaries on the short tokens: a bare 'UV' matched as a substring collects "pyruvate" and "recurvature", and a bare 'MAA' collects any word containing it.

busco_download_path.description: Reuse an existing BUSCO lineage cache.

contrasts.description: Id,factor,level,reference; null = every level vs reference_level. Default: assets/contrasts.csv in the pipeline directory.

strandedness.description: Library strandedness: reverse, forward or unstranded.

strandedness_check.description: Salmon detects the library type per sample with -l A; when true, a detection that disagrees with `strandedness` fails that sample instead of being printed and forgotten.

min_mapping_rate.description: Fail the run if any library maps below this percentage.

random_seed.description: GSEA's multilevel algorithm is randomised; fix it.

statistics_options.title: Statistics
statistics_options.description: Thresholds shared by DESeq2, enrichment and the figures.

de_min_count.description: A gene needs >= this many counts .

assembly_options.title: Transcriptome assembly
assembly_options.description: The A-D assembly ladder and its thresholds.

min_transcript_len.description: Minimum length of a novel transcript added to the reference.

cluster_longread_id.description: Route B: collapse near-identical long-read isoforms (vsearch --id).

cluster_dedup_id.description: Cross-source dedup / de novo isoform collapse (vsearch --id, and the minimap2 novelty identity).

cluster_min_cov.description: Fraction of a sequence that must align to its representative.

stringtie_class_codes.description: Gffcompare class codes kept as novel loci.

longread_genome_sequence.description: Route A sequences from the GENOME at the collapsed models' exon coordinates (gffread -w) instead of the Iso-Seq consensus.
longread_genome_sequence.help_text: Route A sequences from the GENOME at the collapsed models' exon coordinates (gffread -w) instead of the Iso-Seq consensus. The HQ consensus carries homopolymer indels (1.26 frameshifts/kb against the genome on this project) that break ORFs: the same models with genome bases scored CDS BUSCO 71.3% against 68.2%. Identical to SQANTI3's *_corrected.fasta. false keeps the consensus (a genome of a different strain/population than the reads, say).

dge_reference.description: Which ladder rung the expression filter and the analysis start from.
dge_reference.help_text: which ladder rung feeds quantification. Names read as the sources they contain, in the order they were layered: isoseq                           Iso-Seq models collapsed on the genome (route A) isoseq_stringtie                 + genome-guided short-read loci the long reads missed isoseq_stringtie_trinity         + de novo loci absent from the draft genome isoseq_stringtie_lrfree          + reference-free long-read loci, no Trinity isoseq_stringtie_trinity_lrfree  all four sources merged all_sources_dedup                after cross-source deduplication (vsearch, 95%) The expression filter then derives all_sources_dedup_expressed from the rung named here, and THAT is what is annotated, quantified and tested.

tx2gene_rules.description: Per-source transcript -> gene rules: 'prefix:isoform_suffix_regex', ';'-separated, first match wins, empty regex = no grouping (gene == transcript).
tx2gene_rules.help_text: Per-source transcript -> gene rules: 'prefix:isoform_suffix_regex', ';'-separated, first match wins, empty regex = no grouping (gene == transcript). Used for the string-stripped tx2gene map; the locus rebuild below is the coordinate-based alternative.

cdhit_longread_id.description: Deprecated alias for cluster_longread_id; named after CD-HIT, which this pipeline does not run.
cdhit_longread_id.help_text: Kept so an existing params file keeps working: when set it overrides cluster_longread_id. The clustering is vsearch and the novelty test is minimap2. Use cluster_longread_id; this name will be removed in 3.0.0.

cdhit_dedup_id.description: Deprecated alias for cluster_dedup_id; named after CD-HIT, which this pipeline does not run.
cdhit_dedup_id.help_text: Kept so an existing params file keeps working: when set it overrides cluster_dedup_id. The clustering is vsearch and the novelty test is minimap2. Use cluster_dedup_id; this name will be removed in 3.0.0.

expr_filter_tpm.description: TPM a transcript must reach to stay in the analysed set (0 disables the filter).
expr_filter_tpm.help_text: The ladder applies no expression evidence at any rung, so its tip is a cross-source union carrying every near-duplicate and every unexpressed fragment. One salmon pass over that tip decides what the experiment actually saw, and the survivors become the ANALYSED set: they are what gets annotated, re-quantified, tested, enriched and plotted. expr_filter_tpm = 0 disables the filter and the ladder tip itself is analysed instead (one salmon pass either way). The rule is a PRESENCE rule, not a mean: a transcript expressed in one treatment group and absent elsewhere survives. What the filter does not touch is the assembly -- every rung keeps its own FASTA, seqkit stats and BUSCO summary, so the transcript count and the completeness quoted for the transcriptome stay properties of the full deduplicated set. There is deliberately no second route in: an earlier version could rescue a transcript on ORF + homology support, and measured on this dataset that bought 0 DE genes and +0.127 pts of mapping rate while making the reference worse where it counts (56,599 tx at C:72.1% S:45.5% D:26.6% with it, against 48,224 tx at C:70.6% S:48.2% D:22.4% without).

expr_filter_reads.description: Estimated reads (salmon NumReads) a transcript must reach in a library for that library to count. 0 = off.
expr_filter_reads.help_text: An alternative presence test to expr_filter_tpm, on the same first salmon pass and the same expr_filter_samples rule. TPM is length-normalised, so a short transcript and a long one at the same molar abundance pass alike; a read count is raw evidence, so it will not admit a transcript that only looks abundant because it is short. The two disagree most at the extremes of the length distribution, which is where spurious assembly fragments live. Set expr_filter_tpm = 0 and this to 5 for a pure read-count rule; set both for the intersection (a library must pass both tests to count). Both at 0 switches the filter off entirely, and the ladder tip is annotated and tested instead.

expr_filter_samples.description: Number of libraries in which a transcript must reach expr_filter_tpm.
expr_filter_samples.help_text: The ladder applies no expression evidence at any rung, so its tip is a cross-source union carrying every near-duplicate and every unexpressed fragment. One salmon pass over that tip decides what the experiment actually saw, and the survivors become the ANALYSED set: they are what gets annotated, re-quantified, tested, enriched and plotted. expr_filter_tpm = 0 disables the filter and the ladder tip itself is analysed instead (one salmon pass either way). The rule is a PRESENCE rule, not a mean: a transcript expressed in one treatment group and absent elsewhere survives. What the filter does not touch is the assembly -- every rung keeps its own FASTA, seqkit stats and BUSCO summary, so the transcript count and the completeness quoted for the transcriptome stay properties of the full deduplicated set. There is deliberately no second route in: an earlier version could rescue a transcript on ORF + homology support, and measured on this dataset that bought 0 DE genes and +0.127 pts of mapping rate while making the reference worse where it counts (56,599 tx at C:72.1% S:45.5% D:26.6% with it, against 48,224 tx at C:70.6% S:48.2% D:22.4% without).

dge_primary_map.description: String | locus | corset; the other two are still built and published as sensitivity arms.

locus_mincov.description: Min fraction of a transcript that must align to the genome; matches cluster_min_cov / novelty_min_cov so one coverage rule decides "this transcript is represented" everywhere.

skip_genome_guided.description: Route A (long reads on the genome).

skip_sqanti.description: SQANTI3 structural QC of the long-read models.

skip_corset.description: Gene map from salmon equivalence classes.

corset_use_groups.description: True passes -g <condition>: circular for DE (gene splits use the tested labels).

dashboard_title.description: Heading on the dashboard; defaults to the reference set.

environment_options.title: Environment modules
environment_options.description: Provisioning without containers or conda (-profile envmodules).

corset_bin.description: Corset has no environment module here; point this at a bin/ that provides it.

r_libs.description: Extra R library path (DESeq2, apeglm, clusterProfiler, ...) for -profile envmodules.
r_libs.help_text: Extra R library path (DESeq2, apeglm, clusterProfiler, ...) for -profile envmodules. The bioconductor module has no apeglm, so without it shrinkage silently degrades to ashr. Never set it with containers: a host library would shadow the container's packages.

genemap_eval.description: Directory of externally-computed gene-map evaluation tables; enables the dashboard's primary-map rationale card.
genemap_eval.help_text: Which transcript-to-gene map is primary cannot be decided from a run's own outputs, because a map that calls more differentially expressed genes is not thereby the better map. Deciding needs independent truth and a label-permutation null, both computed outside this pipeline. Point this at a directory holding any of: genemap_eval.tsv (map, truth, F1, ARI, split_pct, merge_pct, genes_per_label, fused_pct), genemap_null.tsv (map, false_calls_mean, n_perms) and genemap_verdict.txt (free text). The dashboard renders a comparison card from whatever is present and omits it entirely when this is unset.

extra_path.description: Prepended to PATH for TransDecoder, gffread (envmodules).

generic_options.title: Generic options
generic_options.description: Less common options for the pipeline, typically set in a config file.

outdir.description: The output directory where the results will be saved.

institutional_config_options.title: Institutional config options
institutional_config_options.description: Parameters used to describe centralised config profiles.
